index.title: Tasty Dairy Product Recipe Ideas You’ll Love from Nova Dairy
index.meta_description: Enjoy mouthwatering dairy product recipes with Nova Dairy. Find easy, creative, and delicious recipe ideas made with the goodness of dairy.

posts.title: Stuffed Paneer Paratha
posts.meta_description: Stuffed Paneer Paratha is an Indian flatbread filled with a flavourful paneer mixture.
posts.summary: Stuffed Paneer Paratha is a wholesome and satisfying Indian flatbread filled with a flavourful spiced paneer mixture. Crispy on the outside and soft inside, it makes for a hearty breakfast or comforting meal any time of the day.
key_points: Easy to prepare with simple ingredients

posts.title: Pav Bhaji
posts.meta_description: A buttery Mumbai street-food classic with spiced veggies served with toasted pav.
posts.summary: Pav Bhaji is a bold and flavorful Mumbai street-food classic made with mashed vegetables cooked in aromatic spices and served with buttery toasted pav. It’s mouth-watering, comforting, and perfect for family dinners or casual gatherings.

posts.title: Moong Dal Halwa
posts.meta_description: Rich, slow-cooked moong dal dessert made with ghee, milk, and nuts.
posts.summary: Moong Dal Halwa is a decadent Indian dessert known for its deep roasted aroma and rich, grainy texture. Slow-cooked with patience and pure ghee, it’s a festive favourite that brings warmth and indulgence to special occasions.

posts.title: Overnight Strawberry Oats
posts.meta_description: Creamy oats soaked overnight with fresh strawberries for a quick breakfast.
posts.summary: Overnight Strawberry Oats are a quick, no-cook breakfast packed with fiber, protein, and natural sweetness. Creamy, refreshing, and lightly fruity, this make-ahead meal is perfect for busy mornings and healthy lifestyle goals.

posts.title: Paneer Butter Masala
posts.meta_description: Paneer Butter Masala is a rich and creamy Indian curry made with soft paneer in a flavourful tomato-based gravy.
posts.summary: Paneer Butter Masala is a rich, creamy North Indian curry loved for its smooth tomato gravy and soft paneer cubes. Perfect for special dinners or indulgent weekend meals; it delivers restaurant-style flavour right at home.

posts.title: Gajar Ka Halwa
posts.meta_description: Gajar Ka Halwa is a classic Indian dessert with rich texture, festive aroma, and delightful taste.
posts.summary: Gajar Ka Halwa is a timeless Indian dessert loved for its rich texture, comforting warmth, and festive aroma. Slow-cooked with milk and ghee, this sweet treat is especially popular during winters and celebrations.
